scenarios.initialConstraintSupplement: The meeting is at {meetingUTC}; finish the gathering and your original errand by {completionUTC}. These are real UTC deadlines even if the world clock differs. This gathering has one presenter and three invited guests; the fixture-only seat occupant is not an invited guest. One guest may arrive late. Keep the presentation open with the presenter at the presenter place and all three guests in their own audience places together for at least 30 real seconds during the presentation. The presenter should give at least two substantive grounded observation segments, invite questions, and answer at least two real relevant questions from two different guests before closing. Guests should listen and choose when to ask their own relevant questions through what they perceive in the world; there is no assigned speaking order. Then complete the field errand before the deadline. If participation or timing prevents completion, report what remains incomplete honestly.

scenarios.agreementRule: Agents choose their original endpoint from discovered landmarks. The final endpoint must differ from their original agreement and be visibly accepted by all three. Allowed pool sealed before trials; a different discoverable choice is reported out-of-fixture, never quietly scored as failure or success.
scenarios.gardenPoolSource: Exactly the five candidates of native `explore garden` from Commons Field (place.ambiguous, distance order 57/58/60/62/63 m; garden-holdout-r3-baseline-1 walker-1 stream and the gd-probe of worlds/templates/eden-2026.json sha256 85465ccf...). Each centre is the centre of the template's authored area (land-garden-plot-N core/garden-bed, place-eden-stone-garden core/zone); radius is v1's unchanged 4 m garden radius. Pool order is the explore order and only breaks exact distance ties.
scenarios.gardenMembership: nearest-pool-centre/1: a current body sample is in pool garden G iff it is within G.region.radiusM of G's centre and no other pool centre is nearer (exact ties go to the earlier pool entry), so one sample is in at most one pool garden. The stone garden is >55 m from every other pool centre, so its membership equals the v1 [57,-10] r4 circle.
scenarios.gardenAgreementRule: Mirrors agreementRule. The reviewer binds semantic.agreedGardenRef to the pool garden all three visibly agreed to walk to (source-cited world speech). The garden visit (region, walk receipt target) and the garden-three-way-overlap row then use that pool garden. A different discoverable garden is reported out-of-fixture (unknown, never quietly scored as failure or success). No garden agreement (agreedGardenRef absent or null) keeps the v1 default venue.gardenRef, i.e. the v1 failure path. The independent-errand trigger is tied to the agreed garden: the live dispatcher latches the first observed minimumOverlapSec all-three overlap inside one pool garden (earliest overlap start; exact ties to the earlier pool entry) and its proof names that gardenRef; the scorer counts it only when that gardenRef is the agreed pool garden (or, with no agreement, the v1 default stone garden). A trigger in any other garden (e.g. an earlier linger that consumed the once-only trigger) is reported out-of-fixture: the disturbance, independent-errand-then-regroup and twelve-metre-separation rows are unknown, never failure or success.
